record_title: Positive-weight generalized Romberg quadrature for every integer refinement factor
scientific_context: For nested composite trapezoidal rules with any integer refinement factor r>=2, depth-d Richardson extrapolation has strictly positive final sample weights. The largest weight is H times product_{j=1}^d (1-r^{-2j})^{-1}, and positivity makes the collected rule optimally conditioned for bounded absolute sample errors.
limitations: Nested uniform trapezoidal grids with integer refinement only; exact final rule aggregation; no claim for arbitrary division sequences, rational extrapolation, intermediate floating-point tableau cancellation, stochastic or relative noise, or sampling-efficiency superiority. Classical r=2 positivity is prior work, and older generalized-extrapolation literature leaves residual historical-equivalence uncertainty for r>=3.

artifact_inventory.description: Exact-rational verification of positivity, normalization, polynomial moments, and alternating-tail magnitude growth over representative integer refinement factors and depths.
Deterministic verified output, including software version, number of exact cases, representative non-dyadic weight statistics, and PASS status.
